competing_hypotheses: Direct Cell records, cCellGame live pools, cCellSerializableData, and the generic persistence manager are layers of one universal CellSerializer envelope.
Direct records are content templates, cCellGame is runtime state, cCellSerializableData is a separate progression/save candidate, and the generic manager owns cross-domain serialization.
cCellSerializableData is emitted in whole or in part by the original save path, but only its field-level write/read relation and mode handoff are unknown.
The current CellGame serializable-data flag is a runtime projection and must not be treated as proof of original save coverage.

confidence.scope: Layer separation and structural candidates; exact field emission, transaction order, and cross-stage handoff remain unresolved.

downstream_impact.architecture_effect: Collapsing these layers would make decoded content appear saved state, live pooled objects appear serializable, and a mode-local progression object appear global. Keeping them separate determines codec ownership, state identity, teardown behavior, and whether Cell, creature, Space, and editor transitions can share a save schema.

method.conflict_selection: Select contradictions that can alter ownership, state layering, service boundaries, serialization, package sequencing, root closure, or replacement promotion across more than one package; exclude shallow type-only disagreements unless they change one of those boundaries.
method.count_policy: Use exact source counts with scope labels. Treat overlapping caller counts and package candidate sets as non-additive; use union only when the source explicitly defines it.
method.deduplication_policy: Do not collapse separate conflicts merely because they share a type or artifact. Merge only identical subject, layer, claim, and resolution boundary; preserve source wording and alternatives otherwise.
method.evidence_policy: Static evidence is not original runtime truth. SDK names, vtable candidates, decompiler output, and current source remain bounded to their source layer. No positive original runtime trace is available for gameplay, save/load, or cross-stage behavior.
method.preservation_policy: Retain both sides of every selected contradiction, including resolved representation boundaries, preferred claims with limits, and unresolved alternatives.
method.ranking_policy: Rank by cross-package architectural leverage and blocker severity, not by type-table size or shallow confidence.
